public_rationale: The referenced round closed at $6.6 billion. SoftBank's financial report confirms a separate $10 billion investment completed on April 15, 2025. That exceeds the required amount and precedes even the beginning of July. The observable repeat-financing prediction is supported; the records do not prove that raising it was unavoidable.
limitations: Support applies to the predicted financing event, not a counterfactual finding of financial necessity.
The $10 billion first closing is sufficient; the full announced round is not treated as cash received by July.

our_interpretation: The deadline is July 31, 2025, the latest day the stated month can mean.
At least the same size means at least the amount actually raised in the referenced October round.

The ordinary forecast is that OpenAI would return for another large primary financing. Raising capital must include a completed investment, not merely an announcement, credit facility or secondary share sale.
Will have to is assessed as a prediction of repeat financing; the financing's occurrence cannot independently prove that no alternative was available.
Financing amounts are measured using transaction terms disclosed by the company or its investors, rather than an earnings accounting standard.
criteria.support_condition: After completing the referenced round, OpenAI receives at least that round's amount in a subsequent primary financing by July 31, 2025.
criteria.contradiction_condition: The antecedent occurs, but reliable financing records establish that no subsequent qualifying financing was completed by July 31, 2025.
